name: show-evidence
description: Prove a finished change with replayable, claim-first evidence. Writes a short list of falsifiable claims, records one artifact per claim (Playwright video and trace for UI, a Playwright request trace or a vhs tape or a Hurl transcript for an API, a script run for a CLI or library), and leaves a summary a reviewer can re-run. Each claim is PROVEN, FAILED, or NOT-EVIDENCED.
